faqs.q: Do shoppers need to add the product to cart?
faqs.a: No. Shoppers can request a quote directly from the design editor without adding anything to cart.

faqs.q: What do I see in a request?
faqs.a: The shopper's design, product details, quantity and any notes they add.

faqs.q: Can I send a different price for each request?
faqs.a: Yes. You reply with a custom price based on what the shopper asked for.

faqs.q: Can I use quotes on some products only?
faqs.a: Yes. You choose which products offer quote requests.
